label: Certiorari denied
caption: MILLER, DAVID E., ET AL. V. PARKER, COMM’R, TN DOC, ET AL.
text: The application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice Sotomayor and by her referred to the Court is denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied. Justice Sotomayor, dissenting from the denial of the application for stay and the denial of certiorari: I dissent for the reasons set out in Miller v. Parker, 586 U. S. ___ (2018) (Sotomayor, J., dissenting).
